Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Talbros Automotive Components Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, achieving a total income of INR242 crores and an EBITDA margin of 17.6%. Management highlighted healthy industry demand across key vehicle categories and noted growth drivers such as premiumisation, vehicle electrification, and a new revenue stream from data center generator gaskets. The company reaffirmed its FY27 revenue growth target of 18% to 20% with margins around 17% to 17.5%, alongside planned capital expenditure of INR103 crores for the year. Talbros Automotive Components Limited released its Q1 FY27 investor presentation, highlighting a consolidated revenue of Rs. 238.4 crores and total income of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company targets group revenue growth of about 18% to 20% for FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we continue to continue to have a target group revenue target of about 18% to 20%, with margins being in the range of about 17-odd percent, a little bit maybe 17.5% because we're still working out the whole impact of the inflationary pressures.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting to increase its export contribution to 35% by FY28.
guidance.quote: We are targeting to take our exports to 35% by FY28.

guidance.claim: Management expects the gasket division revenue to reach INR850 crores to INR900 crores in the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: Regarding your 2 divisions, sorry to interruypotu your 2 divisions, gaskets and forging the next 3 years to 4 years, I easily see gasket going to about INR850 crores to INR900 crores and forging at about INR650 crores to INR700 crores.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering a 15% to 20% year-on-year growth in '27.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering a 15% to 20% year-on-year growth in '27.

guidance.claim: Management targets maintaining EBITDA margins between 17% to 18% through product mix, operational leverage, and cost management.
guidance.quote: Our focus will be to maintain EBITDA margins between 17% to 18% through product mix and operational leverage as well as cost management.

guidance.claim: Top line for FY27 is targeted to cross INR 1,000 crores.
guidance.quote: We are targeting for crossing INR1,000 crores this year, definitely.

guidance.claim: Marelli JV is expected to grow between 35% to 40% and Marugo around 15% in the next year top line guidance.
guidance.quote: Next year, I'm expecting Marelli maybe should to grow between 35% to 40% and Marugo should be around 15%. This is the top line guidance.

demand_outlook.claim: The passenger vehicle industry recorded sales of approximately 1.27 million units, registering a 26% year-on-year growth.
demand_outlook.quote: The passenger vehicle industry recorded sales of approximately 1.27 million units, registering a growth of 26% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: The 2-wheeler segment grew by almost 20% year-on-year at 5.63 million units.
demand_outlook.quote: The 2-wheeler segment also continues recovery with a growth of almost 20% year-on-year at 5.63 million units.

demand_outlook.claim: Commercial vehicles recorded an industry volume of nearly 2.83 lakh units, registering a 15% growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Commercial vehicles recorded steady performance during quarter with industry volume of nearly 2.83 lakh units, registering a healthy 15% growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Electric vehicle passenger vehicle volume grew by 87% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: EV passenger vehicles volume grew by 87% year-on-year, while electric 2-wheeler continued to gain market share.
EV passenger vehicles volume grew by 87% year-on-year, while electric 2-wheeler continued to gain market share. with a growth of approximately 68%, supported by increasing charging infrastructure.

demand_outlook.claim: Global OEMs reducing China dependence are accelerating supply-chain realignments toward reliable alternate geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: Global OEMs reducing China dependence are accelerating supply-chain realignments toward reliable alternate geographies

demand_outlook.claim: Passenger vehicle segment continued momentum in Q4 FY26 with highest ever Q4 sales of 13.16 lakh units representing 13% Y-o-Y growth.
demand_outlook.quote: In quarter 4 FY26, the passenger vehicle segment continued its momentum, posting its highest ever quarter 4 sales of 13.16 lakh units, representing a 13% Y-0-Y growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Two-wheeler industry registered highest quarter sales of 57.73 lakh units, a growth of 26% Y-o-Y.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler industry registered its highest quarter for sales of 57.73 lakh units, a growth of 26% Y-0-Y.

demand_outlook.claim: Commercial vehicle segment delivered highest ever quarter volumes, recording 3.25 lakh units sold.
demand_outlook.quote: The commercial vehicle segment delivered its highest ever quarter for volumes, recording 3.25 lakh units sold.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is still looking good in quarter 1 as management speaks.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is still looking good in quarter 1 as I speak. and we are going to add capacities accordingly.

capex_expansion.claim: Planned capital expenditure for the year is about INR103 crores across gaskets, forgings, and heat shields.
capex_expansion.quote: Our planned capex is about INR103 crores for the year across gaskets, forgings, heat shields and to try and meet the demands of the OEM.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex is planned at Rs. 51 crores for FY26 and Rs. 103 crores for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Total cupex v FY26: INR 51 crs v Y27 INR 103 crs

capex_expansion.claim: Gujarat facility capex for the chassis JV is shifted to FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: Now with the order we have received on Maruti and Tata Motors. So accordingly, the SOP will start on later date, so we will — the capex of Gujarat will be now be shifted to 27, '28.

capex_expansion.claim: Gasket and Heat Shield division expects to invest INR 16 crores capex primarily for new business.
capex_expansion.quote: So this year, we are expecting to invest INR16 crores capex in Gasket and Heat Shield, primarily for the new business, plus the new business we are expecting from Cummins USA andto take growth of--

capex_expansion.claim: Forging division will put a capex of INR 60 crores for new business.
capex_expansion.quote: In the forging, we will put a capex of INR60 crores for the new business of Marelli, we discussed on INR9O crores plus other businesses of DANA and GKN.

capex_expansion.claim: Marelli JV expects a capex of around INR 20 crores to add machines for European customers.
capex_expansion.quote: Now, coming to Marelli. Marelli, we are expecting to do a capex of around INR20 crores, because we need to add more machines for our European customers balance.

capex_expansion.claim: Marugo JV will do a capex of around INR 7 crores required for plant and equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: And Marugo will do a capex of around INR7 crores, which is required for basically plant and equipment because their machines are not very, very expensive.

margins_costs.claim: Total income for Q1 stood at INR242 crores, registering a growth of 15% year-on-year with EBITDA at INR43 crores at a margin of 17.6%.
margins_costs.quote: During Q1, our total income stood at INR242 crores, registering a growth of 15% year-on-year. EBITDA at INR43 crores at a margin of 17.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Gasket and heat shield division reported revenue of INR164 crores, growing by 21% year-on-year, and EBITDA increased to INR29 crores with a growth of 32%.
margins_costs.quote: The division reported revenue of INR164 crores of the INR242 crores I mentioned to you, growing by 21% year-on-year. And EBITDA increased to INR29 crores with a growth of 32%.

margins_costs.claim: Talbros Marugo revenue for the quarter stood at INR40 crores with EBITDA of INR6 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Now coming to our JV Talbros Marugo. Revenue for the quarter stood at INR40 crores registering a growth of 31% on Y-0-Y basis. EBITDA stood at INR6 crores, a growth of 57% on Y-0-Y basis.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 17.6%, an increase of 110 bps year-on-year.
Q4 FY26 EBITDA stood at INR 45 crores with a record high margin of 18.7%.
margins_costs.quote: At the EBITDA level, at Q4, we declared EBITDA of INR45 crores, a growth of 12.9% and a record high margin of 18.7%, reflecting robust operating leverage and disciplined cost ‘management.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 EBITDA stood at INR 155 crores with an EBITDA margin of 17.5%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for FY26 stood at INR155 crores as against INR147 crores in FY25. EBITDA margin remained healthy at 17.5%, reflecting the benefits of operational improvement, cost management initiatives and a better product mix.

margins_costs.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia led to an increase in raw material and freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: Geopolitical tensions in the West Asia region led to an increase in raw material and freight costs.

orders_capacity.quote: We continue to maintain our leadership position with nearly 50% market share in the domestic gasket market and a single source of many, many OEMs.

orders_capacity.claim: New domestic orders worth INR 170 crores have been secured for hoses and anti-vibration products.
orders_capacity.quote: New domestic orders worth INR170 crores have been secured for hoses and anti-vibration products, showing good growth in the coming new years.

orders_capacity.claim: Talbros holds a 50% market share in the Indian Gasket market.
orders_capacity.quote: We hold a 50% market share in the Indian Gasket market, 3 times the nearest competitor and are market leaders across two-wheelers, agri, off-highway and commercial vehicle segment.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to maintain a healthy balance sheet while investing in future growth opportunities.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a healthy balance sheet while investing in future growth opportunities through capacity expansion, ~technological enhancement and product diversification.

risks_headwinds.claim: Margins during the quarter witnessed temporary pressure from elevated commodity prices and inflation costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Margins during the quarter witnessed temporary pressure on account of elevated commodity prices, particularly steel and aluminium as well as other inflation costs such as labour increases in some states.

risks_headwinds.claim: West Asia war may lead to some temporary cost pressures and potential shipment delays.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the West Asia war may lead to some temporary cost pressures, inquiries remain strong, and we believe Talbros is well placed to navigate these challenges.
